name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-thinking-loop-guard
description: Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus three mid-stream breakers that end a single call repeating itself — maxRepeatedText for identical visible deltas, maxRepeatedCycleChars for a cycled visible bleed, and maxRepeatedReasoningCycleChars for a cycled bleed in the REASONING channel, which no other shipped rule can reach (the visible breaker never sees a reasoning delta, and the per-call judgement reads reasoning only after the call has ended). Ships an offline session analyzer that replays a session jsonl through the same decision rules and reports its own parse coverage, so a zero over an unreadable file cannot be mistaken for health. Compatible with every published dsh line from 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.2.0-rc.2 (each one run); writes its reactions under a producer-owned message source, because session format v4 refuses the retired bare `plugin` kind.
